title: Length-Controlled AlpacaEval: A Simple Way to Debias Automatic Evaluators

bias_targets.methodology: Fitting a generalized linear model (GLM) to predict evaluator preferences based on output length differences, and measuring the change in win rates when models are prompted to be verbose versus concise.
Comparing the win rates and leaderboard rankings of models when evaluated by different LLM judges (including the models themselves) to assess if judges favor their own outputs.
